title: Coast Guard rescues 3 fishermen, dog near Wachapreague, Va.
description: A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, rescues three fishermen and a dog near Wachapreague, Virginia, Sept. 3, 2016. The fishermens' vessel became disabled during the impact of Tropical Storm Hermine. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina.
